integrity: Sarkar–Gupta exact stationary random-comb drift and the existing trap boundary are credited; the new mathematical claim is only the nonuniform singular weak-return asymptotic with nonconstant phase and critical logarithmic law. Analytical proof and a separate standalone algebraic/numeric checker are included.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotics are for positive biased rates, iid geometric integer tooth lengths, and ordered limits: stationary finite volume, infinite volume, then vanishing return rate. The theorem does not cover simultaneous finite-volume/weak-return scaling, other disorder tails, non-Poisson returns, particle interactions, or noisy-data stability. Publication-priority originality is not externally certified.
title: Nonanalytic reset-onset and log-periodic mobility in a disordered random comb
